purpose: Response-free known-truth 2x2 factorial testing whether structural added value depends on residual structural novelty relative to the reference and response-aligned updating.

design.static_layer_b: per-node mean structural latent state over fitting contexts reused for every context

known_truth.saturated_reference: weak reference plus exact current structural_latent
known_truth.misaligned_structural_feature: node mean structural_latent over training contexts reused at all contexts

estimands.cell_delta: augmented minus baseline heldout log loss within replicate; negative favors structural augmentation
estimands.reference_saturation_penalty: delta(saturated,aligned) - delta(weak,aligned); positive means structural benefit shrinks when reference already contains structure
estimands.static_alignment_penalty_under_weak_refe: delta(weak,static) - delta(weak,aligned); positive means static reuse loses value under dynamic truth

forbidden_interpretations: Synthetic effect sizes estimate any historical ecological endpoint.
The factorial proves which moderator caused the A-Islands versus Tanzania contrast.
The factorial proves which moderator caused the Azores or Louisiana versus Tampa contrast.
Passing the factorial establishes universal structural predictive benefit.
The factorial authorizes reopening, repairing, or rerunning any consumed ecological endpoint.
